Name: (Content Patcher) Better Together - SVE Spouse Buffs
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
[center][size=4][u]﻿[/u][/size][size=4][u][/u][/size][size=4][u][b]This mod's concept comes directly from AirynS's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17792]Spouse and Roommate Buffs mod[/url]﻿.[/b][/u][/size][/center]
[i][size=2]As Airyn has made it clear that he is not going to add SVE support to his mods, I made this to fill in the gap. [b]Permission was granted to me from Airyn in the comments of his mod to upload this mod for other SVE players like myself to use[/b], however [b]this upload is not affiliated with Airyn or his work at all[/b]. Please do not seek support from Airyn if you run into an issue with one of the buffs granted by an SVE NPC.[/size][/i][b][center][size=4]
Available Translations:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28271/]ES: by Hayato2236[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19337]VH: by CuongNguyen0903﻿﻿[/url]﻿[/size][/center][/b]
A buff is added to the player when they either become roommates with Apples, or marry either Claire, Lance, Magnus, Olivia, Sophia, or Victor. The buffs granted can be configured to either 'Minor,' 'Default,' or 'Potent,' Minor granting a +1 buff to all but Max Energy (with a +20 buff to Max Energy), Default granting a +3 buff to all but Max Energy (with a +35 buff to Max Energy), and Potent granting a +5 buff to all but Max Energy (with a +75 buff to Max Energy).
[b]
The buffs each NPC grants are as follows:[/b]
[spoiler][b]Apples [/b](Roommate): Forest Magic - [i]Buff to Farming skill[/i].
[b]Claire [/b](Spouse): Early Riser - [i]Buff to movement Speed[/i].
[b]Lance [/b](Spouse): The First Slash - [i]Buff to Attack[/i].
[b]Magnus [/b](Spouse): Sigil of Protection - [i]Buff to Defense[/i].
[b]Olivia [/b](Spouse): Artisinal Aficionado - [i]Buff to Farming skill[/i].
[b]Sophia [/b](Spouse): Better Days Ahead - [i]Buff to Max Energy[/i].
[b]Victor [/b](Spouse): Labor Union - [i]Buff to Defense.[/i][/spoiler]
[b]Install like any other mod: extract the [CP] Better Together - SVE Spouse Buffs folder into your mods folder.[/b] You will need SVE for this mod to work. You do not need Airyn's mod, but if you are looking for Vanilla or RSV NPCs, his mod has those all covered.

[b]I do not know how well this mod works with Free Love. I do not use a multiple spouse mod. There may be issues which I can not fix.[/b]
[b]
Some quirks I know of:[/b]
[spoiler]- Stardew Valley only shows so many buff slots at any given time. [b]I believe the cap is 4 displayed buffs[/b]. That's more than adequate for Vanilla, after all. Do not ask me to fix that. I don't know how and it is far out of the scope of what I use this mod for.

- As far as I know, without a lot more research and work I am not interested in doing, [b]this mod can not do any accounting for an "official" or "active" spouse such as Free Love features[/b]. I do not plan on adding a token that will switch buffs based on the "official" spouse, as it would be pointless to me and the people I play with.[/spoiler]
Thank you to Airyn for granting his permission to upload this mod.

[i]Other mods present in the mod image: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿. Not required but highly recommended.[/i]
